quote: achieves 81.0 F1 on the OntoNotes benchmark

WL F1 means word-level CoNLL-2012 F1 score, i.e. the coreference metric on the word-level dataset; SA is the span extraction accuracy or the percentage of correctly predicted spans; SL F1 is the span-level CoNLL-2012 F1 score, the basic coreference metric.
